title: Rabbi Chanina bar Andrai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1, folio 4a, he says in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Soter: “The angels have no knees.” In Yefeh Mar’eh on the aggadot of the Jerusalem Talmud he is copied as Rabbi Muna bar Andrai; in Megillah 4:5, Rabbi Chinena bar Andrai in the name of Rabbi Zakkai of Kabul.
